levels.label: Rights-safe chapter appendix
levels.status_display: Original synthetic prose and media plan
levels.allowed_claim: The candidate specifies four narrative beats, synthetic audio tokens, original visual treatment, and reader controls.
levels.forbidden_inference: The appendix is the product chapter, product authorship, or a soundtrack-backed runtime capture.

levels.label: Reader and authoring capability
levels.status_display: Repository documents the reader seam; direct current proof is open
levels.allowed_claim: The repository documents manifest-driven chapters, motion, layered audio, authoring, and reader controls.
levels.forbidden_inference: The current hosted reader synchronizes every layer or passes an accessibility audit.

levels.label: Chapter, asset, and attribution rights
levels.allowed_claim: The local contribution ledger identifies the missing chapter, soundtrack, font, sensitive-content, and AI/human decisions.
levels.forbidden_inference: Repository ownership or bot commits establish publication permission or a complete authorship statement.

levels.label: Reader control and accessibility
levels.status_display: Controls are specified, not directly exercised here
levels.allowed_claim: The intended contract includes mute, reduced motion, keyboard navigation, and font scale.
levels.forbidden_inference: The live reader has passed a current direct-surface accessibility audit.

levels.label: Local material package
levels.status_display: Candidate page, short copy, ledger, and 16:9 preview
levels.allowed_claim: A local candidate packet makes the synthetic narrative and rights boundary inspectable without repository assets.
levels.forbidden_inference: The candidate page is hosted or has been posted to a destination.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Hosting and external publication remain open gates.
levels.forbidden_inference: The case is live on GitHub, a portfolio, Handshake, or another destination.
